title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named Chico State spaces for quiet work, group projects, presentations, restorative breaks, recreation, and between-class meetups.

cards.title: Settle Into The Grove for Quiet Work
cards.subtitle: First floor of Meriam Library
cards.notes: Bring solo reading or focused laptop work; the library designates The Grove for quiet study and directs group work elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor library space for individual study with low conversational noise.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library identifies The Grove as a first-floor study space and states that it is a quiet area not appropriate for group study.
cards.access_notes: Located on Meriam Library's first floor; follow current library access hours and quiet-study rules.

cards.title: Start a Work Session in the Research Commons
cards.subtitle: West side of Meriam Library's first floor
cards.notes: Use this named commons as a clear meetup point before choosing nearby solo or collaborative seating elsewhere in the library.
cards.short_summary: A map-identified first-floor study area that works as an easy group rendezvous.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library's current floor map lists the Research Commons among the study spaces on the west side of the first floor.
cards.access_notes: Use during current Meriam Library building hours and observe posted rules for the first-floor area.

cards.title: Take Deadline Work to the Silent Study Floor
cards.subtitle: Third floor of Meriam Library
cards.notes: Choose this floor for individual concentration, silence your phone, and move conversations or group sessions to another level.
cards.short_summary: The library's explicitly designated floor for silent, individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library designates its third floor, apart from east-side group rooms, for silent individual study with no phone use or group study.
cards.access_notes: Available during current library hours; silence and individual-study restrictions apply outside the designated group rooms.

cards.title: Book Room 260 for a Study-Break Game
cards.subtitle: Second floor of Meriam Library
cards.notes: Reserve the room first, then borrow controllers or a library game at checkout if your group wants a structured study break.
cards.short_summary: A reservable group room combining a table, whiteboard, large monitor, and Xbox.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library identifies Room 260 as an Xbox-equipped group study room and instructs students to reserve it before use.
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; controllers and library games must be borrowed from the checkout desk under current lending rules.

cards.title: Move Group Work to the Rose Garden Room
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor of Meriam Library
cards.notes: Meet here when discussion is part of the assignment; the fourth floor supports collaborative work, unlike the silent third floor.
cards.short_summary: A named fourth-floor room within the library's collaborative-study level.
cards.evidence_claim: Meriam Library's floor map places the Rose Garden Room on the fourth floor, which the library designates for group and collaborative study.
cards.access_notes: Use during current fourth-floor library hours; keep group noise considerate and follow any room signage.

cards.entity_name: The Well at Bell Memorial Union
cards.title: Build a Rest Break Into the Day at The Well
cards.subtitle: Basement of Bell Memorial Union
cards.notes: Drop in for quiet time or study with a lap desk; reserve specialized amenities ahead when availability matters to your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A student wellness space with quiet, creative, sensory, reflection, and study options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Well's official FAQ says students may study there with provided lap desks and identifies quiet, creative, sensory, meditation, and reflection spaces.
cards.access_notes: Open to currently enrolled Chico State students; the posted schedule is Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-5 p.m. Reservations are recommended for select amenities.

cards.entity_name: Bell Memorial Union Second Floor Lounge
cards.title: Use the BMU Lounge for a Flexible Meetup
cards.subtitle: Second floor of Bell Memorial Union
cards.notes: Meet a small group here to study, relax, or eat without booking a conference room; keep the shared lounge usable for others.
cards.short_summary: An open campus-community lounge suited to meals, studying, and small meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: The current BMU Facility Handbook says the second-floor lounge is open to the campus community for studying, relaxing, small-group meetings, or meals.
cards.access_notes: Non-reservable and open to the campus community during BMU building hours; comply with current facility policies.

cards.entity_name: Behavioral and Social Sciences Building Study Platforms
cards.title: Find an Indoor-Garden Study Perch
cards.subtitle: Inside the Behavioral and Social Sciences Building
cards.notes: Look for the open or enclosed study platforms around the indoor garden when you need a between-class workspace in this building.
cards.short_summary: Study platforms integrated with bridges, daylight, and a living indoor garden.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State describes the BSS Building as containing an indoor garden with living trees, bridges, and platforms for open and enclosed study.
cards.access_notes: Use during current BSS Building access hours; individual platforms may be unavailable during classes, events, or maintenance.

cards.title: Pair a Study Session With BSS Support
cards.subtitle: Behavioral and Social Sciences Building, Room 111
cards.notes: Bring individual work or classmates from a BSS course, then ask the center about advising or tutoring when your questions go beyond study time.
cards.short_summary: A department-based space combining study seating with advising and tutoring support.
cards.evidence_claim: Chico State lists BSS Building Room 111 as a Student Success Center offering individual and group study space to students enrolled in BSS courses.
cards.source_title: Student Success and Advising – Chico State
cards.access_notes: For students enrolled in one or more BSS courses; posted hours are Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-5 p.m., excluding academic holidays.

cards.title: Reset Between Classes on the Pool Deck
cards.subtitle: Outdoor aquatics area at the WREC
cards.notes: Check the current aquatics schedule, then use designated swim space or a lounge chair while lifeguards supervise the deck.
cards.short_summary: A supervised outdoor recreation area with lap swimming, free swimming, and lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The WREC aquatics page documents an outdoor pool and spa deck with lounge chairs, designated lap and free-swim areas, and lifeguard supervision.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on current WREC eligibility, operating hours, aquatics schedules, capacity, and posted pool-safety requirements.
